verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS tax API with an official CLI and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out for Stripe Tax, the Stripe CLI or the MCP server. The only privacy-adjacent item is IP geolocation for tax estimates, which is optional customer-location input, not a telemetry control.
